newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Broker BBG launches first Czech fund in Canada.
newsitem.headline: Broker BBG launches first Czech fund in Canada.

text.p: Brno Broker Group (BBG) on Monday said it had launched the Czech Fund, the first Czech-based mutual fund to be registered in Canada.
In a statement BBG said the C$30 million fund, which will cater to institutional investors and "high-net-worth individuals", would be marketed in Canada by Brenark Securities.
The Czech Fund is registered in Canada as a unit trust fund with the Ontario Securities Commission.

"This is probably the first such emerging market fund where the shots are being called locally, by locals in conjunction with Western expertise as opposed to decisions being made far removed from investments," the statement said.
It added that the fund will concentrate on Czech equities, which will comprise some 80 percent of its portfolio, "and possibly similar investments in Hungary and Poland (20 percent)".
